Class FirestoreImportOrdersTest

@IsTest()
private class FirestoreImportOrdersTest

Unit tests for the FirestoreImportOrders class. Validates order import from Firestore including item aggregation, tax calculations, customization processing, and currency conversion.

Group:
    Test Classes

Since:
    04/03/2021

Version:
    1.4


Change Log

  • 04/03/2021 - v1.0 - Initial version.
  • 04/21/2021 - v1.1 - Orders now contain tax data.
  • 06/03/2021 - v1.2 - Methods now use class FirestoreService instead of FirestoreController.
  • 03/05/2024 - v1.3 - The account currency is now used to define the order currency.
  • 03/28/2026 - v1.4 - Update ApexDoc comments, assertions, and method naming to follow standard format. API version updated to 66.0.
